cases.title: Signed asset lifecycle
cases.expectation: Registration, mint, transfer and burn complete; a forged transfer is rejected without changing the snapshot; final supply is zero and the snapshot restores.

cases.title: Malformed keys and signature tampering
cases.expectation: Malformed key lengths, suite encodings, changed hybrid signature components and wrong messages fail verification.

cases.title: Two custodians plus the owner
cases.expectation: Missing custodian authorization rejects mint without changing the snapshot; transfer requires the owner and both configured custodians.

cases.title: Classical-shaped owner key rejection
cases.expectation: An output using a classical-shaped owner key is rejected and the local snapshot remains unchanged.

cases.title: Joint authorization and replay rejection
cases.expectation: Both native assets exchange with unchanged supplies; replay is rejected without changing the settled snapshot, which restores successfully.

cases.title: Second-leg tampering rolls back the pair
cases.expectation: Tampering with either hybrid signature component in the second leg rejects settlement and preserves the entire pre-settlement snapshot.

cases.title: Single-leg signatures cannot authorize a pair
cases.expectation: Ordinary transaction signatures cannot substitute for joint pair authorization by owners or governance; each rejection preserves the snapshot.

cases.title: Pool custody and position ownership
cases.expectation: The local prototype adds liquidity, swaps, rejects replay and position theft, restores reserve locks and ownership, removes the authorized position, and preserves each asset supply. This does not activate a live AMM.
